positions.title: Learning Management Systems Specialist
positions.description:
Edit images and provide HTML 5 layouts for Security Awareness page.
Perform system maintenance including managing semesters, uploading courses, and extracting report data.
Manage all specialize tools in an LMS, including calendars and announcements, language packages, anti-plagiarism tools and plugins and extensions.
Provide second-tier support to users; assist in troubleshooting of LMS technical issues; and work expeditiously with Manager of Online Learning Technologies and LMS vendor to resolve problems.
Help support the Academic Technology Group in effectively using the LMS to incorporate multimedia in the teaching and learning process.
Provide layout and images to new Desire2Learn version 10.5.
Provide fully accessible template and help documents for all students and instructors, especially students with disabilities.

positions.title: Computer Information System Tutor
positions.description:
Tutor more than 7 subjects at Oakland Community College computer lab including: Microsoft Office Suite 2013: MS Word, MS Office, MS Access, MS PowerPoint
Programming and Scripting Languages: JavaScript, Java, Mobile Web Application Development (Android SDK)
Object-oriented languages: Java, JavaScript, JQuery, Android SDK
Web Technologies: HTML5, CSS, Dreamweaver
Database: SQL, MS Access, MySQL
Operating System: Window 7
Help approximately 10 students per week in daily basic to have fundamental understandings at various computer subjects.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
Install, maintain, and troubleshoot servers, desktops, printers, fax lines, phone systems, access points, and network for both profit and non-profit organizations such as hospitals, schools, churches, and museums.
Install and support various software to each user’s needs such as Financial Edges, Patron Edges, Event Pro, Retail Pro, MS Office, printers, and Paychex.
Synchronize outlook and phone’s calendars and contacts.
Design company’s website and write its web content using WordPress and Photoshop.
Assist to program telephone systems.
Create tickets and troubleshoot web-based system issues such as Financial Edges, Patron Edges.
Fix and troubleshoot computer hardware and software, replace hardware components, and upgrade computer’s memory and operating systems.
